.²1 Placed apart.

A mode of construction in which words or phrases which
 are separated from one another by some other

 intervening words, phrases or sentences are construed together as forming
 a sentence. This mode is as a general rule not admissible and is worse
 than even {#lakzaRA#} (see {#vyavaDAna#}); {#satraviSvajitsambanDe vyavahitakalpanA#}
 {#syAt#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 33</ls>, <ls n="ŚB. on MS.">7. 4. 10</ls>.
